name: CCteam-creator
description: Multi-agent team orchestration skill for Claude Code. Set up parallel AI agent teams with file-based planning and role-based collaboration.

capability_evidence.multi-agent-orchestration: , you orchestrate multiple specialized agents — developers, researchers, testers, reviewers — working together on your project.
capability_evidence.parallel-execution: mmarizes the team roster, task assignments, and dependency graph.
capability_evidence.session-persistence: tly, persist state to files, follow built-in protocols
capability_evidence.memory-context: **control plane** owning user alignment, phase gates, and the team's durable operating rules.
capability_evidence.notifications: ilently fetches the latest plugin.json version from GitHub and notifies you (one line, no confirmation needed) if a newer version is available.

analysis.summary_en: One skill, a full engineering team.
highlights: Manages collaboration — agents communicate directly, persist state to files, follow built-in protocols
Sets up everything — planning files, docs/ knowledge base, CLAUDE.md operations guide, agent onboarding
Consults with you — explains how agent teams work, understands your project, recommends a team
After 3+ occurrences, custodian encodes it into golden_rules.py as an automated check
